description: Ask Studocu to generate a quiz or mock exam from 1 to 10 project sources. Can take about 3 minutes. If status is creating or outcome_unknown, check get-project-state before calling again.

artifact_ids.description: 1 to 10 different project source ids to generate from. Each id looks like studocu://project/{project_id}/source/{uuid} and must belong to project_id. Get them from add-document-sources or get-project-state. Do not pass creation ids.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key, 1-256 characters. Send the same key when you retry the same request. A different request body with a used key is rejected. Omit to let Studocu derive a key from the request; identical retries still count as the same request.

instruction.description: Optional hint, 1-6000 characters. Example: "focus on chapter 3". Omit for a general quiz or mock exam.

project_id.description: UUID of the project that owns the project sources. Example: 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111. From create-project or get-context.

type.description: What to generate: quiz or mockExam.

name: request-creation

artifact_id.description: Agent OS artifact ID of the new creation. Present when status is created.

external_id.description: Quiz id or mock-exam id. Present when status is created or creating. Match it on get-project-state. Omitted when the call times out.

status.description: created: saved, with artifact_id and external_id. creating: generation finished but the new creation is not linked yet; match external_id on get-project-state. outcome_unknown: the call timed out or a duplicate is still running; check get-project-state and do not send a new retry key. Failures come back as errors, not as a status.

title: Generate Quiz or Mock Exam
